name: Mosshome
description:
Mosshome is a ruined settlement above the town of Bone Bottom. It is built around the burial spire of a Weaver who warded and healed its inhabitants with her thread, earning their reverence. This Weaver may be Camora, Weaver of healing, as an effigy to her can be found near Mosshome.

What's here
Items: Silkspear; Druid's Eye given by Moss Druid after completing the Berry Picking wish; Druid's Eyes given by Moss Druid after bringing them 4 additional Mossberries; Frayed Rosary String; Mossberry; Mossberry Stew given by Moss Druid during the Great Taste of Pharloom wish
NPCs: Moss Druid; Garmond and Zaza (Act 3 only)

name: Bone Bottom
description:
Bone Bottom is a small town that leads to the Marrow. It is inhabited by pilgrims, whose objective is to reach the Citadel. It is composed of tents and bone pieces.

What's here
Items: Spool Fragment; Memory Locket given for completing the Volatile Flintbeetles wish; Rosary Necklace given for completing the Garb of the Pilgrims wish; Heavy Rosary Necklace given for completing the The Terrible Tyrant wish; Hornet Statuette given by Flick the Fixer after completing the An Icon of Hope wish; Weaver Effigy; Choral Commandment; Mossberry; Maiden's Soul given by Chapel Maid during the Silk and Soul wish
NPCs: Pebb; Shakra; Flick the Fixer; Chapel Maid; Pilby; Fearful Pilgrim; Horned Pilgrim; Quiet Pilgrim; Solemn Pilgrim; Courier Tipp (during the My Missing Courier wish); Mister Mushroom (Act 3 only)
Bosses: Skull Tyrant (after defeating Skull Tyrant in the Marrow)

name: Bonegrave
description:
Bonegrave is a vast graveyard beyond the Ruined Chapel, where fallen pilgrims are buried. It can be accessed from the Wormways after opening the Simple Key door, or from above the Ruined Chapel with Cling Grip.

What's here
Items: Mossberry; Plasmium Cocoon Act 3 only; containing 2 Winged Lifeseeds
NPCs: Sula
Bosses: Summoned Saviour

name: Moss Grotto
description:
Moss Grotto is a lush, verdant cave overgrown with plant life. Relatively secluded from the rest of the lowlands, it is covered in vivid lime-green moss and plants, with pools of clear water. A large pit in the Grotto's rough centre extends up into the enormous cavern that houses Bone Bottom, continuing past it all the way to the top of the Blasted Steps. To the left of this pit, the flora and fauna are more prominent, while to the right, the moss gives way to the foundation of bone and rock underneath.

What's here
Items: Frayed Rosary String; Beast Shard dropped from Marrowmaw; Mossberry
Bosses: Moss Mother (Act 3 only)
